fusions.name: Drawn Venom
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 8 poison damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lance and Drain
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more for each one. It then leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Returned Bitterness
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Gap in the Cure
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
